text: Process online payments from users
quote: Process online payments

text: Accept payments via card, PayPal, Venmo, PayPal Pay Later, ACH, and Apple Pay
quote: Facilitate payments from users to your customers via card, PayPal, Venmo, PayPal Pay Later, ACH, and Apple Pay.

text: Process in-person payments with a device
quote: Process payments with a device

text: Tap to Phone contactless payments via Rainforest SDK on iOS and Android devices
quote: Rainforest currently supports processing Tap to Phone payments utilizing the Rainforest SDK on iOS and Android devices.

text: Successful payments return a stored payment method reusable for future payments
quote: All successful payments return a stored payment method that can be utilized for future payments.

text: Configurable embeddable payment component that handles both card and ACH payments on behalf of merchants
quote: Accept payments from users on behalf of merchants via a configurable embedded component. Utilize the same component for card and ACH payments.

text: Payment component collects sensitive payment data without exposing the platform, reducing PCI DSS scope
quote: The payment component collects sensitive payment data from your user without exposing your platform to the sensitive payment data - increasing security and decreasing PCI DSS scope.

text: Pre-built embeddable components for payments, reporting, chargebacks, and merchant onboarding
quote: Start processing payments in days, not months. Reduce development time and get to revenue faster with our pre-built, embeddable components for payments, reporting, chargebacks, merchant onboarding, and more.

text: Component Studio to visually configure and design embedded components
quote: Head over to our Component Studio to configure and design the Rainforest components for your platform integration

text: Component props support business logic and custom CSS styling
quote: Props are used for business logic and to pass custom CSS styling to the components

text: Payins can be processed via the payment component or directly via the Rainforest API
quote: Rainforest offers two options to process payins: **Payment Component (Recommended)**... **Rainforest API**

text: Merchants can be onboarded via an onboarding component, the Platform Portal, or the API
quote: Rainforest offers three options to onboard merchants: **Merchant Onboarding Component (Recommended)**... **Rainforest Platform Portal**... **Rainforest API**

text: Create a merchant with an initial merchant application through the API
quote: Create a merchant with an initial merchant application.

text: Real-time onboarding lets merchants start processing payments in minutes
quote: Utilizing our embedded component or API, submit for real-time onboarding processing payments in minutes.

text: Platform Portal lets platform staff enter onboarding information on behalf of merchants
quote: The Rainforest Platform Portal has the option to use the Merchant Onboarding Component to input merchant onboarding information on behalf of your merchants.

text: Approved platforms can send sensitive onboarding data like bank accounts and SSNs directly via API
quote: Platforms that are approved by Rainforest can send sensitive merchant onboarding data, including bank accounts and Social Security Numbers, to Rainforest via a direct to API integration.

text: Rainforest performs KYC/KYB verification and returns approved, declined, or manual review within minutes
quote: Rainforest performs the Know Your Customer (KYC) and Know Your Business (KYB) verifications requirement by the card brands and provides you with an approved, declined, or manual review response within minutes.

text: Real-time bank account validation through Plaid during onboarding
quote: Rainforest utilizes a third-party partner, Plaid, for real-time validation.

text: Pre-submission verifications reduce data entry errors and can speed application approval
quote: Configuring these verifications to run before submission reduces data entry errors and potentially expedites the application approval process.

text: Merchant applications move to a Needs Information status when more verification is required
quote: Merchant application moves to the **Needs Information** status and requires additional verification for merchant onboarding

text: Split a payin amount, routing fixed or rate-based allocations to the platform or specified merchants
quote: Each split routes a defined amount or rate-based allocation to the platform or specified merchant.

text: Configure amount splits on the payin itself
quote: You can implement amount splits in three steps: Configure the payin to apply the amount splits

text: Buy-rate, interchange-plus pricing model with no revenue split
quote: We lead with a buy-rate, interchange-plus pricing model, and have no revenue split. See how much money you could save versus a flat rate model below.

text: Platforms fully control how much they bill merchants, keeping pricing and interchange optimizations
quote: Yes! You totally control how much you bill your merchants. And with our buy-rate model, any optimization to pricing or interchange costs goes directly to your bottom line.

text: Each merchant is assigned a Billing Profile that sets the fees and rates billed to them
quote: Every merchant is assigned a Billing Profile to determine the fees and rates that are billed to the merchant.

text: Revenue calculator generates a detailed payments revenue model from 6 questions
quote: Calculate your revenue potential. Answer 6 questions to generate a detailed revenue model.

text: Deposit frequency can be updated per active merchant via the Update merchant endpoint
quote: For **Active** merchants, the deposit frequency can be updated by setting the new deposit frequency on the [Update merchant](https://docs.rainforestpay.com/reference/update_merchant) endpoint.

text: Webhook notifications for payment, merchant, and deposit events
quote: Configure Rainforest to send webhook notifications for any payment, merchant, or deposit events

text: Webhooks report every status change across the chargeback lifecycle
quote: Webhooks can be configured to receive updates on every status change that occurs through the lifecycle of a chargeback.

text: Guidance for receiving webhooks in private networks without a public inbound endpoint
quote: It covers three patterns for receiving Rainforest webhooks to an on-prem service.

text: Zapier integration to route webhook events to email, Slack, or other apps without code
quote: You can configure a workflow to notify your support staff via email, Slack, or other apps when Rainforest sends webhooks.

text: Full end-to-end sandbox testing with test card and bank account numbers producing set outcomes
quote: Detailed guides and walkthroughs, full end-to-end sandbox testing, realtime API logs, and more.

text: Realtime API logs for debugging integrations
quote: Detailed guides and walkthroughs, full end-to-end sandbox testing, realtime API logs, and more.

text: OpenAPI 3.1.0 specification of the Rainforest API
quote: Rainforest supports OpenAPI Specifications (OAS) of the Rainforest API, version 3.1.0.

text: Long-lived API keys authorize server communication with the API
quote: An API key is a long-lived credential that authorizes servers to communicate with the Rainforest API.

text: Short-lived sessions (max 24 hours) with statements of permissions and constraints scoping resources and actions
quote: A **statement** consists of a set of **permissions** and **constraints** that defines what **resources** and **actions** this session can access.

text: Platforms retain full ownership of payment and merchant data and can export it at any time
quote: Platforms using Rainforest retain full ownership of all payment and merchant data and may export it at any time.
